## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request targets the `dev` branch.
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/), for example `feat(board): drag cards between lanes`.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), certifying the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/).
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` pass.
- [ ] Tests that cover the change were added or updated, and the affected tests pass.
- [ ] New source files start with the licence header.
- [ ] A new dependency, if any, is explained here and is licence-compatible (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] User-visible changes are reflected in the documentation.
